verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Gmail natively handling SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat conversations alongside email in the same inbox. The only related item is a community report about the third-party SMS Backup+ app archiving texts into Gmail, which is a user-side workaround and not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
